notes.title: FLAG scenario added to the GAME
notes.notes:
A new scenario "FLAG" has been added for the Battle Royale mode.

Take control of the FLAG and feel the new dynamics of the battle.

notes.title: Price drop
notes.notes: Playing your favourite games at home is a great way to pass the time in our present circumstances, which is why we've decided to lower the game's price so that even more people can enjoy Total Lockdown. And to those who didn't hesitate to purchase the game right at release, we're sending two the largest set of gold bars as a thank-you gift. Stay safe, stay home, and play Total Lockdown.

notes.title: Game Release
notes.notes: Panzar Studio is proud to announce that Total Lockdown has been successfully launched! Join the deadly reality show or watch others play. Choose a corporation that you like, invite your friends, try Tournament Mode and, above all, remember: It’s time to have fun!
